simple.summary: נוּם (nûwm) means to slumber (from drowsiness) First listed occurrence: Isa 5 27.

definitions.full: H5123. num נוּם verb be drowsy, slumber (Late Hebrew נִמְנֵם נוּם, id. ; Aramaic נוּם , ; Arabic () id. ; Ethiopic ); — Qal Perfect 3plural נָמ֫וּ Nahum 3:18 ; Psa 76:6 (Ges § 72 l ); Imperfect יָנוּם 121:3 2 t.; 3 feminine singular וַתָּ֫נָם 2Sam 4:6 (so read for HCT וַיַּכֻּהו , with other radical changes, ᵐ5 Th We Dr Kit Bu HPS); Infinitive construct לָנוּם Isa 56:10 . — be drowsy, slumber , literal וַתִּישָׁ֑ן וַתָּנָם 2Sam 4:6 (emendation, see above) and she grew drowsy and slept ; figurative of inactivity, indolence, Isa 5:27 (|| ישׁן ), Psa 121:3 ; 121:4 (of ׳י ; || id. ); Nahum 3:18 (|| שָׁכֵן ); לָנ ׳אֹהֲבֵי Isa 56:10 (|| שָׁכַב ); followed by accusative of congnate meaning with verb שֵׁנָה Psa 76:6 (of death, || נִרְדַּם ).
